follow_up_questions.question: Do you have any numbness in your thumb, index or middle finger, or are your fingers cold, pale or swelling more under the brace?
follow_up_questions.why: Worsening median nerve symptoms or compromised circulation would need urgent attention.

follow_up_questions.question: Did you hit your head or hurt anything else, like your other wrist, hip or back, when you fell?
follow_up_questions.why: A fall on the stairs can cause other injuries that were not checked.

follow_up_questions.question: What medications do you take, including blood thinners or antidepressants, and do you have any drug allergies?
follow_up_questions.why: Needed before surgery and before starting Ultram, which interacts with serotonergic drugs.

follow_up_questions.question: Which is your dominant hand, and have you ever been told you have osteoporosis?
follow_up_questions.why: Hand dominance affects recovery planning and a low-energy wrist fracture may warrant bone density evaluation.
